title: Practice 2: Doing it fully, to the end

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: What does по- add in поза́втракать?
options: doing the action for some time
completing an action, covering its object fully or in part
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists поза́втракать under this meaning of по-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «по-», meaning 3 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/по-).
**подпишу** — подписа́ть (perfective): to sign (one's own name); to add to; to subscribe, to take out a subscription for someone. Wiktionary: под- + писа́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **подпишет** — подписа́ть (perfective): to sign (one's own name); to add to; to subscribe, to take out a subscription for someone. Wiktionary: под- + писа́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to scrutinize, to peer, to look carefully
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: заду́мать — to devise; изму́читься — to suffer; преувели́чить — to exaggerate, to overstate; всма́триваться — to scrutinize, to peer, to look carefully.

exercises.q: What does на- add in напи́ться?
options: to repletion, to satiation, to the full, enough, too much
(added to nouns, forms adverbs with the meaning in the direction of the noun)
(added to nouns or adverbs, forms adverbs with the approximate meaning 'for' the noun or adverb, or in the state of the noun or adverb)
exercises.why: Wiktionary lists напи́ться under this meaning of на-. Source: Wiktionary, «на-» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/на-#Russian).

exercises.q: What does из- add in изму́читься?
options: destroying, reducing to nothing by use
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists изму́читься under this meaning of из-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «из-», meaning 2 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/из-).

exercises.q: What does в- add in всма́триваться?
options: giving or acquiring a status or state
the manner of an action, given by the base word
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists всма́триваться under this meaning of в-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «в-», meaning 2 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/в-).
